results.title: EU: Low-Value Consignment Relief Abolished and EUR 3 Customs Duty Introduced from 1 July 2026
results.snippet: The EU has abolished the low-value consignment relief and introduced a EUR 3 customs duty per item from 1 July 2026, with the Union handling fee still to be fixed.

results.title: European Commission Sets Proposed EU Customs Handling Fee at EUR 2 per E-Commerce Item
results.snippet: The European Commission has set the proposed EU customs handling fee at EUR 2 per e-commerce item, payable on consignments below and above the EUR 150 threshold.
